description: This file defines API routes for handling Supabase database webhook events related to 'tasks' table changes. It includes verification of webhook secrets, processing webhook payloads, and triggering email notifications based on database events like INSERT and UPDATE.

classes.name: SupabaseWebhookPayload
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the payload sent by Supabase webhooks for database change events.

methods.name: bool _constant_time_equals(a: str, b: str)
methods.description: Performs a timing-attack-resistant comparison of two strings.

methods.name: None _verify_supabase_hook_secret(request: Request)
methods.description: Verifies the incoming request's secret header matches the expected secret, using constant-time comparison.

methods.name: str|None _as_str(v: Any)
methods.description: Converts various input values to trimmed strings or None.

methods.name: bool _records_differ(old: dict[str, Any] | None, new: dict[str, Any] | None, key: str)
methods.description: Determines if a specific field differs between old and new database record states.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _extract_task_fields(record: dict[str, Any] | None)
methods.description: Extracts common task-related fields from a webhook record.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] supabase_tasks_webhook( payload: SupabaseWebhookPayload, request: Request, _auth: None = Depends(_verify_supabase_hook_secret), )
methods.description: API endpoint handling Supabase database change webhooks for tasks table, triggering emails on insert/update events.

ctags.name: _records_differ
ctags.pattern: /^def _records_differ(old: dict[str, Any] | None, new: dict[str, Any] | None, key: str) -> bool:$/
ctags.signature: (old: dict[str, Any] | None, new: dict[str, Any] | None, key: str)

ctags.name: supabase_tasks_webhook
ctags.signature: ( payload: SupabaseWebhookPayload, request: Request, _auth: None = Depends(_verify_supabase_hook_secret), )

ctags.name: table
ctags.pattern: /^    table: str = Field(..., description="Table name that triggered the event.")$/

ctags.name: type
ctags.pattern: /^    type: str = Field(..., description="Event type, e.g. INSERT\/UPDATE\/DELETE.")$/
